text: On October 25, 2024, Exhibition Place released our official “Roadmap to Net Zero Carbon”, as part of our commitment to the global Net Zero Carbon Events Pledge for the exhibition and convention industry. The roadmap is being promoted on our social media channels and our website.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (November 28, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
